Scatter plot of two indicators, animated by year

Source: R/fct_plots.R
plot_scatter.Rd

One point per country, colored by its group (EU, EFTA, candidate), on axes that stay the same for all the years, with the correlation of the two indicators across the countries of each year.

Usage

plot_scatter(x_data, y_data, x_indicator, y_indicator)

Arguments

x_data, y_data

Data frames from get_indicator().

x_indicator, y_indicator

The ids of the two indicators in indicators().

Value

A plotly object, or NULL when the two indicators have no year in common.

Examples

x <- data.frame(
  geo = c("EL", "BG", "DE", "NO"), country = c("Greece", "Bulgaria", "Germany", "Norway"),
  group = c("EU", "EU", "EU", "EFTA"), year = 2024, value = c(70, 66, 116, 130)
)
y <- transform(x, value = c(81.9, 75.9, 81.2, 83.4))
plot_scatter(x, y, "gdp_pps", "life_expectancy")
